notes: DOCUMENTED TARGET - NOT RECORDABLE (agent_supports: partial, daemon_capability: incapable). This spec states the arc the row asserts so a future re-assessment has something concrete to compare against; it is NOT expected to pass on mistral-vibe as it stands, and it is deliberately NOT weakened to match what vibe can do. THE ROW: a blocking dialog belonging to NO tool call - ready -> working -> waiting entered while the modal is on screen with nothing in flight to carry the entry, waiting -> working -> ready once the user answers with nothing completing to carry the release, and a final ready surviving a >=15s trailing idle. AGENT LAYER (the half that fails, and why it is 'partial' not 'no'): vibe 2.19.1 DOES have one dialog of this class - the first-use workspace trust prompt, the scenario's own trigger 2 (setup/trusted_folders/trust_folder_dialog.py, built by core/trusted_folders.py:118). But it is raised from check_and_resolve_trusted_folder (cli/entrypoint.py:173) through run_cli's resolve_trusted_folder callback at cli/cli.py:458-460 - BEFORE load_session (:481) and before _run_interactive_mode (:485). The startup update prompt (:457) is earlier still, and the two input() y/N prompts (entrypoint.py:223, :241 - worktree removal, branch deletion) run after run_cli returns. So every tool-less blocking dialog vibe has lives outside the AgentLoop: no `send` can elicit one, and there is no live session to move working -> waiting. THE OTHER THREE TRIGGERS WERE CHECKED AND ARE ABSENT: a case-insensitive package-wide scan for 'sandbox' returns zero hits (no sandbox/network confirmation); a scan for 'elicit' returns zero hits (no server-driven MCP elicitation - the MCP-OAuth and connector-auth modals at cli/textual_ui/widgets/{mcp_oauth_app,connector_auth_app}.py are raised from MCPApp messages, i.e. the user's own /mcp slash command from the idle input app); and the auto-mode/settings-review trigger is absent in the blocking sense - cli/plan_offer is CTA text appended to a message body (app.py:3979-3983), and the model/theme/thinking/config/proxy pickers are user-invoked slash commands. MID-SESSION, VIBE HOLDS EXACTLY TWO BLOCKING FUTURES and both belong to a tool call: _pending_approval (app.py:513, awaited by _approval_callback :2008 for a tool permission gate) and _pending_question (:514, awaited by _user_input_callback :2036 for ask_user_question / exit_plan_mode). Those are scenarios 2.19/2.26 and 2.17/2.18 - exactly the substitution this row forbids. There is no third. TRANSPORT LAYER (the second, independent blocker): vibe's Source is FilesUnderRoot over ~/.vibe/logs/session/<id>/messages.jsonl, and that directory is created lazily inside _save_interaction_sync (core/session/session_logger.py:~255) - i.e. on the first save, which cannot happen before the AgentLoop exists. During a launch-time dialog the only thing the daemon sees is the transient proc-<PID> presession row the CommandPattern scanner mints from the running vibe process, born ready. The row's FIRST assertion (working) is unproducible, not merely its waiting leg. The one case a future assessor will try - `vibe --continue` in an untrusted cwd, where the session dir already exists from a prior run - fails too: the dialog still blocks before load_session, messages.jsonl is untouched, and the only hook irrlicht installs is post_agent_turn (vibe/hooks.go), which fires at turn end. The session sits at ready for the whole dialog. THAT LAST FACT IS THE VACUOUS-PASS TRAP: ready is coincidentally the row's terminal state, so a spec weakened to assert only 'final state ready' would go green having observed nothing. The phases below are therefore kept unweakened, and the settle_hold phase is not the only assertion. LOAD-BEARING ENVIRONMENT PRECONDITION for any future recording, not an assumption: the trust dialog is SELF-SUPPRESSING. maybe_build_workspace_trust_prompt returns None when cwd is $HOME, when the cwd is already trusted, when it is explicitly untrusted, or when it contains no trustable files; answering once persists the decision to ~/.vibe/trusted_folders.json (add_trusted/add_untrusted, core/trusted_folders.py:183-189); and --trust, --worktree and --add-dir all call trust_for_session up front (cli/entrypoint.py:329, :342). Any recording must re-probe that file for the recording cwd and assert the dialog actually appeared. ANCHORING follows this column's confirmed presession shape (see 2-1 basic-turn's backflow note): a transient proc-<PID> row is born ready before the lazily-created transcript dir appears, then reconciles into the real session_<id> under a DIFFERENT session_id, so the birth is two phases and every later phase chains through same_session_as: session_birth. A real turn opens first, deliberately, so that a transcript-backed session exists for the dialog's arc to attach to - which is itself the thing vibe cannot provide for a launch-time modal. OBSERVATIONS assert agent only. mistral-vibe's model and tokens come from the meta.json sidecar, which the offline replay golden cannot reproduce (replay stages only transcript.jsonl), so cost_nonzero/tokens_nonzero are false on this whole column - and a model pin on a cell that is never recorded would be a doc-guess.

text: proc-<PID> pre-session appears in ready within 1s of launch (the CommandPattern scanner binds the vibe PID before the transcript dir exists). It never goes working. On vibe this is ALSO the only row that exists while a launch-time trust dialog is on screen.
The real session_<id> reconciles with a DISTINCT session_id when ~/.vibe/logs/session/<id>/ appears (created lazily on the first save). Every phase below anchors here.
vibe PID bound to the real session (matched by cwd via the meta.json sidecar)

A real turn opens the transcript-backed session ready -> working, so there is a session for the dialog's arc to attach to. On vibe today this is already unreachable for a tool-less dialog: every one of them fires before the AgentLoop exists.

THE ENTRY EDGE. A blocking modal that names no tool opens (the class vibe has is the workspace trust prompt, TrustFolderDialog) and the session goes working -> waiting with NO tool call in flight - nothing carries the entry. Up to 15s is allowed because some agents publish this signal on a timer. Substituting vibe's tool-permission dialog (_approval_callback) or its ask_user_question dialog (_user_input_callback) does NOT satisfy this phase - those belong to 2.19/2.26 and 2.17/2.18.
THE RELEASE EDGE. The user answers the modal and the session resumes waiting -> working. Nothing carries the release either: no tool result closes it.
The turn finishes back to ready - full arc ready -> working -> waiting -> working -> ready

THE LOAD-BEARING PHASE. The session is still ready after a >=15s trailing idle: it does not fall back to waiting, and it was not left pinned at waiting from the dialog onward by something no later event retires. NOTE it is not sufficient on its own - a vibe session sits at ready through the whole trust dialog anyway, so this phase alone would pass while observing nothing (see the meta note).
